title: Al-Yaqeen fi Zaman al-Shubuhat
description: A path to accompany your adolescent (13-15) in building unwavering yaqeen amidst doubts: welcoming religious questions, proofs of iman, ikhlas, and the inner watchfulness of Allah—an aqeedah with conviction, not mere taqlid.

primary_reference.info: ثلاثة الأصول والقواعد الأربع لابن عثيمين، العقيدة الطحاوية، أسئلة الأطفال الإيمانية، أصول الإيمان على فهم السلف

review_defects.why: The same term 'شبهات' is transliterated as 'al-Shubuhat' in the title but translated as 'doubts' in the description, creating inconsistency within the document.

review_defects.english: an aqeedah with conviction, not mere taqlid
review_defects.why: The word 'mere' is added, which is not present in the Arabic. The Arabic simply says 'not by taqlid' without the qualifier.
